answer: Anchor identity to scarce, non-replicable history so copies cannot mirror a real agent for free. A legitimate node is like a cedar grown over years on its own island: distinct lived record, costly to fake. A sybil is just a mirror image with no roots, and when challenged to show independent activity the reflection shatters. Because each fake must fund its own island of real compute, duplicating identities costs as much as earning them honestly.
